news.title: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report
news.articleText: Release Number 9316-26 CFTC Announces Semiweekly Publication of the COT Report October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig announced the CFTC’s plan to increase the publication frequency of the Commitments of Traders Report (COT Report) from once to twice a week by the end of 2026. Data from Monday will be published on Wednesday, and data from Wednesday will be published on Friday. Both reports will be released at 3:30 p.m. ET on their respective publication days. Under the enhanced publication schedule, the reports’ latency will decrease from three days to two days. The change follows the Commission’s recent Request for Comment and reflects its commitment to providing market participants with more timely information about trading positions and activity in agricultural markets. The CFTC’s Division of Data is leading the effort to operationalize the expanded publication schedule through modernization and automation while maintaining accuracy. “COT Reports have been an important source of transparency for decades. Following feedback from the agricultural community, I’m pleased to announce the CFTC will be rolling out COT Reports twice a week to ensure this information stream is as useful as possible,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction
news.articleText: Release Number 9315-26 CFTC Sues to Block State Enforcement in Utah Amid Ongoing Efforts to Preserve Jurisdiction October 27, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission announced today it has filed a lawsuit against Utah to block the state’s efforts to shut down CFTC-registered contract markets using state laws. The lawsuit follows Utah’s decision to file civil enforcement actions in state court against CFTC-regulated markets and other businesses. Utah’s effort to restrict the functioning of CFTC-registered exchanges obstructs Congress’s decision to federally preempt state law. “Utah seeks to shut down prediction markets across a wide variety of markets,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “Event contracts do not just serve hedging and investment purposes—they also provide the public with information about the outcome of future events. Congress entrusted the CFTC to be the federal regulator with sole responsibility to oversee these markets. As I’ve said before, the CFTC has the expertise and responsibility to defend its exclusive jurisdiction over commodity derivatives, and that’s exactly what we’ll do.” This action reflects the CFTC’s firm commitment to maintaining its exclusive jurisdiction over CFTC-registered prediction markets. The CFTC continues to draw a clear line: if a state challenges the lawful operation of a derivatives exchange, the Commission will protect federal sovereign interests. The Commission has also initiated legal proceedings against nine other states and has submitted briefs in four federal courts of appeal and one state supreme court. -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC and National Basketball Association Sign MOU to Protect Integrity in Professional Basketball
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC and National Basketball Association Sign MOU to Protect Integrity in Professional Basketball
news.articleText: Release Number 9314-26 CFTC and National Basketball Association Sign MOU to Protect Integrity in Professional Basketball October 26, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the National Basketball Association today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to protect the integrity of professional basketball in prediction markets. Through the MOU, the CFTC and NBA will better share information by regularly communicating and discussing matters relating to integrity, as well as maintaining fair and transparent prediction markets. “I’m pleased the CFTC and NBA signed an MOU which continues the Commission’s commitment to increasing data sharing between the agency and professional sports leagues,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “The NBA joins the MLB and NHL in taking a responsible step toward protecting sports integrity and market participants from abuses in prediction markets like insider trading and fraud. I thank NBA Commissioner Adam Silver for putting the integrity of professional basketball and America’s financial markets first and for working with the CFTC on this MOU.” -CFTC-

news.title: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Louisiana Man and His Companies to Pay Over $9 Million in Forex Fraud
news.verification: Birincil kaynak
news.titleTr: CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Louisiana Man and His Companies to Pay Over $9 Million in Forex Fraud
news.articleText: Release Number 9313-26 CFTC Secures Court Order Directing Louisiana Man and His Companies to Pay Over $9 Million in Forex Fraud October 21, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission today announced the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Louisiana entered a default judgment against defendants Michael B. DePetrillo, Meteor LLC, and NOLA FX Capital Management LLC for their participation in a fraudulent retail forex scheme. In entering the default judgment, the court found the defendants fraudulently solicited and misappropriated more than $3 million from participants. The court found the defendants falsely represented that participant funds would be used to trade retail forex, made material misrepresentations and omissions regarding the profitability of forex trading with them, and issued false account statements to conceal their misconduct. The court further found the defendants misappropriated participant funds by making payments to existing participants in a manner akin to a Ponzi scheme, paying DePetrillo’s personal expenses, and trading in DePetrillo’s personal account. The court ordered the defendants to pay a $9,211,492 civil monetary penalty. The order also permanently enjoins the defendants from further violations of the Commodity Exchange Act and Commission regulations, as charged, and imposes permanent trading and registration bans. The default judgment resolves all claims in the CFTC’s 2024 complaint. [See CFTC Press Release No. 9003-24] On Feb. 18, 2025, in a related criminal case, DePetrillo pleaded guilty to violating the Commodity Exchange Act in connection with the same conduct in the CFTC’s complaint. On July 23, 2025, the court sentenced him to nine years in prison and ordered him to pay $6,748,412 in restitution. The CFTC appreciates the assistance of the U.S. Attorney’s Office for the Eastern District of Louisiana and the FBI New Orleans Division. -CFTC-

Eski SPK Başkanı İbrahim Ömer Gönül, Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya ve eşi İlyas Kaya, yarın şüpheli sıfatıyla ifade vermek üzere savcılığa çağrıldı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İstanbul Cumhuriyet Başsavcılığı Terörizmin Finansmanı ve Aklama Suçları Soruşturma Bürosunca, sermaye piyasalarındaki işlemlere ilişkin yürütülen fon soruşturması devam ediyor. Bu kapsamda, Fatma Betül Sayan Kaya, İlyas Kaya ve eski Sermaye Piyasası Kurulu Başkanı İbrahim Ömer Gönül yarın "şüpheli" sıfatıyla ifadelerinin alınması için emniyet aracılığıyla savcılığa çağrıldı. Kaynak: AA

items.title: Zelensky awards Melania Trump Ukraine's highest award after Oleshky ceasefire
items.summary: Russian and Ukrainian delegations will meet the US first lady at the White House on Thursday.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Zelensky awards Melania Trump Ukraine's highest award after Oleshky ceasefire
items.summaryTr: Russian and Ukrainian delegations will meet the US first lady at the White House on Thursday.
items.articleText: Zelensky awards Melania Trump Ukraine's highest award after Oleshky ceasefire - Published Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky has given the country's highest award for women to the US First Lady, Melania Trump. The Order of Princess Olga, 1st Class, was awarded to Melania Trump for her "significant personal contribution to humanitarian support for Ukraine", according to the presidential decree. It comes after the end of ceasefire in Ukraine's southern region of Kherson, which allowed for the evacuation of several hundred people from the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky. Russian and Ukrainian delegations - made up of ombudsmen who were involved in the evacuation mission as well as senior officials - are due to meet at the White House on Thursday on Melania Trump's invitation. The White House said that Melania Trump had "independently initiated engagement between the two warring nations and successfully secured a ceasefire". "This achievement marks an unprecedented diplomatic initiative by an American First Lady." it added. Both the Russian and Ukrainian sides repeatedly thanked Melania Trump for brokering the ceasefire, though neither elaborated on the nature or extent of her involvement. The delegations travelling to the White House on Thursday will include Ukraine's human rights ombudsman Dmytro Lubinets and his Russian counterpart Yana Lantratova, as well as Ukrainian MP Davyd Arakhamia and Russian senior official Kirill Dmitriev. Lubinets and Lantratova travelled together into Oleshky last week, in an unusual show of cooperation between Russian and Ukrainian officials. Arakhamia, a Ukrainian MP who heads Zelensky's party in parliament, has previously been part of the Ukrainian negotiating team during peace talks with Russia. He was responsible for informal contact between the White House and Moscow during the ceasefire, according to diplomatic sources quoted by Ukrainian media, and has confirmed he will take part in Thursday's talks. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said the Russian delegation will be made up of Lantratova and Kirill Dmitriev, a Russian businessman close to the Kremlin who has frequently taken part in US-brokered ceasefire talks. Although both Dmitriev and Arakhamia are veteran participants in high-level peace negotiations, meetings involving such senior representatives are rarely convened through an initiative led by a US First Lady. No details of what the White House event will entail have been shared. "There are important meetings ahead," said Lubinets in a social media post while announcing he was on his way to the US. On Thursday Melania Trump will also deliver remarks on the ceasefire in Oleshky at 11:00 (16:00 GMT), the White House website said. Zelensky's decree also cited Melania Trump's wider humanitarian work, including her efforts concerning Ukrainian children affected by the war, as reasons for giving her the Princess Olga award. Melania Trump has largely remained discreet on foreign policy matters, but in 2025 she said an "open channel of communication" had been established with Russian President Vladimir Putin, allowing for Ukrainian children displaced in the war to be reunited with families. Earlier this year the UN said the deportation and forcible transfer of Ukrainian children to Russia constitutes a crime against humanity and a war crime. According to Ukraine, almost 20,000 children have been illegally sent to Russia and Belarus since Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Russian, Ukrainian and American representatives are also going to meet in Abu Dhabi next week in the first trilateral meeting since February. The talks will be focused on postwar security agreements and de-escalation, US envoy Steve Witkoff said on Monday.

Lubinets and Lantratova travelled together into Oleshky last week, in an unusual show of cooperation between Russian and Ukrainian officials. Arakhamia, a Ukrainian MP who heads Zelensky's party in parliament, has previously been part of the Ukrainian negotiating team during peace talks with Russia. He was responsible for informal contact between the White House and Moscow during the ceasefire, according to diplomatic sources quoted by Ukrainian media, and has confirmed he will take part in Thursday's talks. Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said the Russian delegation will be made up of Lantratova and Kirill Dmitriev, a Russian businessman close to the Kremlin who has frequently taken part in US-brokered ceasefire talks. Although both Dmitriev and Arakhamia are veteran participants in high-level peace negotiations, meetings involving such senior representatives are rarely convened through an initiative led by a US First Lady. No details of what the White House event will entail have been shared. "There are important meetings ahead," said Lubinets in a social media post while announcing he was on his way to the US. On Thursday Melania Trump will also deliver remarks on the ceasefire in Oleshky at 11:00 (16:00 GMT), the White House website said. Zelensky's decree also cited Melania Trump's wider humanitarian work, including her efforts concerning Ukrainian children affected by the war, as reasons for giving her the Princess Olga award. Melania Trump has largely remained discreet on foreign policy matters, but in 2025 she said an "open channel of communication" had been established with Russian President Vladimir Putin, allowing for Ukrainian children displaced in the war to be reunited with families. Earlier this year the UN said the deportation and forcible transfer of Ukrainian children to Russia constitutes a crime against humanity and a war crime. According to Ukraine, almost 20,000 children have been illegally sent to Russia and Belarus since Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Russian, Ukrainian and American representatives are also going to meet in Abu Dhabi next week in the first trilateral meeting since February. The talks will be focused on postwar security agreements and de-escalation, US envoy Steve Witkoff said on Monday.

items.articleText: AB'de genişleme takvimi netleşiyor: 4 ülke için yol haritası hazırlandı - Avrupa Birliği (AB) Komisyonu, Karadağ, Arnavutluk, Moldova ve Ukrayna'nın üyelik süreçlerini hızlandırmak amacıyla yeni yol haritaları hazırladı. Karadağ'ın 2028'de AB'nin 28'inci üyesi olabileceği belirtilirken, diğer aday ülkeler için de müzakere hedefleri açıklandı. AB Komisyonunun Genişlemeden Sorumlu Üyesi Marta Kos, 2026 Genişleme Paketini Avrupa Parlamentosu Dış İlişkiler Komitesinde sundu. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Son bir yılda üyelik yolunda en fazla ilerleme kaydeden dört ülkeye yönelik yol haritalarının hazırlandığını belirten Kos, her ülkenin reform performansına göre değerlendirileceğini vurguladı. Karadağ için 2028 hedefi Karadağ'ın 21 müzakere faslını geçici olarak kapattığını açıklayan Kos, kalan fasılların da yıl sonuna kadar tamamlanabileceğini söyledi. Katılım antlaşması üzerindeki çalışmaların başladığını belirten Kos, ülkenin 2028'de AB'nin 28'inci üyesi olma yolunda ilerlediğini ifade etti. Arnavutluk'un ise dört faslı geçici olarak kapattığını aktaran Kos, reformların sürdürülmesi halinde ülkenin üyelik müzakerelerini 2027 sonuna kadar tamamlayabileceğini bildirdi. Moldova'nın 2028 başında müzakereleri bitirme hedefi için reformlarını hızlandırması gerektiğini belirten Kos, Ukrayna'nın da hukukun üstünlüğü, demokratik kurumlar ve kamu yönetimi reformlarına öncelik vermesi gerektiğini söyledi. Yeni entegrasyon modeli 2027'de başlayacak Kos, aday ülkelerin tam üyelik öncesinde AB ile daha fazla bütünleşmesini sağlayacak yeni bir kademeli entegrasyon modeli üzerinde çalıştıklarını açıkladı. Bu kapsamda aday ülkelerle görüşmelerin 2027'nin ilk çeyreğinde başlaması planlanıyor. Diğer aday ülkelerin durumuna da değinen Kos, Sırbistan'da ifade özgürlüğü alanında gerileme yaşandığını, Kuzey Makedonya'nın anayasa değişikliklerini tamamlaması gerektiğini belirtti. Bosna Hersek ve Kosova'da siyasi ve kurumsal sorunların reformları geciktirdiğini kaydeden Kos, Gürcistan'ın AB üyelik sürecinin ise fiilen durduğunu ifade etti.

items.summaryTr: Sigortacılık ve Özel Emeklilik Düzenleme ve Denetleme Kurumu (SEDDK), Tera Yatırım'ın Doğa Sigorta ve Prive Sigorta'yı satın alma sürecine ilişkin ortaya atılan iddiaların gerçeği yansıtmadığını bildirdi. Kurum, itibarını zedelemeye yönelik paylaşımlarla ilgili hukuki süreç başlatılacağını açıkladı.
items.articleText: SEDDK'den Tera Yatırım açıklaması: İddialar asılsız, hukuki süreç başlatılacak - Sigortacılık ve Özel Emeklilik Düzenleme ve Denetleme Kurumu (SEDDK), Tera Yatırım'ın Doğa Sigorta ve Prive Sigorta'yı satın alma sürecine ilişkin ortaya atılan iddiaların gerçeği yansıtmadığını bildirdi. - Kurum, itibarını zedelemeye yönelik paylaşımlarla ilgili hukuki süreç başlatılacağını açıkladı. Sigortacılık ve Özel Emeklilik Düzenleme ve Denetleme Kurumu (SEDDK), fon süreci ve Tera Yatırım'ın sigorta şirketlerini satın alma girişimine ilişkin kurum hakkında ortaya atılan iddialara yanıt verdi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle SEDDK'den yapılan açıklamada, kamuoyunu yanlış yönlendirme amacı taşıdığı belirtilen paylaşımlardaki iddiaların bütünüyle asılsız olduğu ve hiçbir hukuki ya da fiili dayanağının bulunmadığı ifade edildi. SEDDK'den Doğa Sigorta ve Prive Sigorta açıklaması Açıklamada, kurumun sermaye piyasalarında yaşanan olumsuz gelişmelerde asli rolü bulunan finansal kuruluşların sigortacılık sektörüne girişini engellediği belirtildi. Böylece söz konusu sorunların sigortacılık sektörüne yayılmasının ve diğer alanlarda büyümesinin önüne geçildiği kaydedildi. SEDDK, yanıltıcı paylaşımlarda adı geçen şirketlerde tespit edilen kayıpların büyük bölümünün eylül ayı sonunda gerçekleştiğini bildirdi. Kayıpların eş zamanlı olarak kurumun gözetimine takıldığı, denetime alındığı ve bir haftadan kısa süre içinde raporlanarak ilgili kurumlara ve adli mercilere iletildiği aktarıldı. Açıklamada, ilgili şirketin 30 Ekim 2026 tarihinde Kamuyu Aydınlatma Platformu'na (KAP) gönderdiği özel durum açıklamasında da SEDDK'nin denetim faaliyetleri ve tespitlerine yer verildiği hatırlatıldı. Şirketlerde yeni tedbirler alındı SEDDK, denetim raporu ve kurumun direktifleri doğrultusunda ilgili şirketlerde yatırım politikalarından iç denetim süreçlerine kadar çeşitli tedbirlerin alındığına ilişkin bilginin kendilerine iletildiğini bildirdi. Kurum, mevzuatla belirlenen görev ve yetki alanı kapsamında gerekli işlemlerin gecikmeksizin gerçekleştirildiğini vurguladı. Hukuki süreç başlatılacak SEDDK açıklamasında, kurumun ve sigortacılık sektörünün itibarını zedelemeye yönelik mesnetsiz iddialarda bulunanlar hakkında hukuki süreç başlatılacağı ve bu süreçlerin hassasiyetle takip edileceği belirtildi. SEDDK, ilgili şirketlerde tespit edilen kayıpların büyük bölümünün eylül ayı sonunda gerçekleştiğini ve denetim sürecinin bir haftadan kısa sürede raporlanarak ilgili kurumlara ve adli mercilere aktarıldığını açıkladı.

items.title: Mother of Ghanaian boy killed in US 'wants justice' as she flies for funeral
items.summary: Police have not made any arrests and an investigation is ongoing as authorities search for three teenage boys.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Mother of Ghanaian boy killed in US 'wants justice' as she flies for funeral
items.summaryTr: Police have not made any arrests and an investigation is ongoing as authorities search for three teenage boys.
items.articleText: Mother of Ghanaian boy killed in US 'wants justice' as she flies for funeral - Published The mother of a 15-year-old Ghanaian boy who was fatally shot in the United States last week has left Ghana for America after being granted an emergency visa by President Donald Trump. "I want justice for my son," Doris Adu Gyamfi told the BBC at the airport before her departure. She said he had dreamt of becoming a medical doctor. Her son, Javits Frimpong, was chased down and shot on Thursday morning on his way to school in the Bronx, New York. He was taken to a local hospital, where he was pronounced dead. Police have not made any arrests and an investigation is ongoing as authorities search for three teenage boys in connection with the shooting. His death has sparked outrage in both Ghana and the US, and reignited the debate about gun violence in America. His mother was escorted to the airport by relatives and Dr Erieka Bennett, Head of Mission of the African Diaspora Forum. "I'm going to America to plan my son's funeral," Gyamfi said. She thanked the government and well-wishers for their support and prayers following her son's death. In a social media post on Saturday, New York mayor Zohran Mamdani said Trump had agreed to grant a visa to Gyamfi so she could mourn her son in person. Mamdani said the murder of a child was a pain no parent should endure, "let alone from thousands of miles away.” "Javits Frimpong's mother deserves to say goodbye to her son in person. I just got off the phone with President Trump, and he has agreed to grant her visa immediately," he said. "All of New York City is mourning this tragedy," he added. Ghana's government has condemned the killing and said it was following the case closely to ensure justice. It has urged US authorities to conduct a thorough investigation and said it was ready to provide legal and consular support to ensure the perpetrators are brought to justice. Police are searching for three teenage suspects who fled the scene, captured on surveillance footage. The shooting has sparked concern among Ghanaians about the safety of children sent to study in America. items.title: Kellogg's admits snap, crackle and pop is quieter after uproar over Rice Krispies recipe change
items.summary: The cereal giant has changed the recipes for Rice Krispies and Coco Pops, sparking a backlash online.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Kellogg's admits snap, crackle and pop is quieter after uproar over Rice Krispies recipe change
items.summaryTr: The cereal giant has changed the recipes for Rice Krispies and Coco Pops, sparking a backlash online.
items.articleText: Kellogg's admits snap, crackle and pop is quieter after uproar over Rice Krispies recipe change - Published Kellogg's has told the BBC the "snap, crackle and pop" sound made by its Rice Krispies may be noticeably quieter after an uproar over the cereal giant's recipe change. Rice Krispies and Coco Pops are no longer being made with whole rice grains, with the tiny toasted puffs being made using corn flour and rice flour instead. A Kellogg's spokesperson said retaining the iconic sound had been a "huge focus" when designing the new recipe, but that customers "might notice that the sound may be quieter and not as instant as before". It followed an online uproar about changes to the breakfast staples, with some fans saying they had lost the "pop" sound altogether. Kellogg's said the recipe was altered due to "changing weather conditions" that have disrupted supplies of some grains and cereals. The cereal giant said the new versions had been "carefully assessed for taste, appearance and texture", but fans complained online they no longer made the famous "pop" sound and said their children would no longer eat them. Some expressed dismay that the taste and texture were "totally different" and dubbed the change "grim" and "disgusting". "There's no snap, crackle and pop in these," a parent named Dani wrote on TikTok. "My toddler won't eat them." Lauren, also posting on TikTok, added that she had been eating Rice Krispies every day for breakfast "for years and years". "I had a bowl of the new recipe and you can immediately tell the difference," she said. "They don't have the snapping sound when you put in the milk." Jessicake meanwhile said they tasted "weird and stale". The "Snap, Crackle and Pop" - made when milk is added to the puffed rice - has been a centrepiece of the brand's marketing since the 1950s. Kellogg's insisted the snap, crackle and pop is "still there, but consumers might notice that the sound may be quieter and not as instant as before". Recipe changes are notoriously difficult for big brands. Chocolate makers are constantly accused of reducing cocoa content in their products and debates rage online over whether ketchup ingredients have changed. When Scottish fizzy drink Irn Bru cut its sugar content in 2018, fans famously stockpiled crates of the old version. No changes are being made to Rice Krispies products in the US and Canada. Kellogg's said the recipe change in the UK would help "maintain consistent quality" as extreme weather takes a toll on crops and pushes up ingredient prices. Extreme weather in Spain in 2022 and 2023 in particular had reduced availability of the types of rice the company uses for its breakfast cereals, the company said Rice Krispies, launched nearly a century ago, are sold around the world and come in variations such as vanilla and strawberry flavours in some markets alongside the widespread chocolate-flavoured Coco Pops version. "We appreciate that even small changes to a much-loved product can feel noticeable and that's why we have approached this with a lot of care and consideration," Kellogg's said. The firm said it appreciated the customer feedback and would "continue to look at ways to make [its] products even better in the future". The cereals have already undergone some change, with reductions in salt content in the 1990s and lowered sugar in 2018. The company said Rice Krispies and Coco Pops will continue to meet UK food standards on levels of fat, salt and sugar in food. A backlash against processed foods in recent years, especially those low in fibre and high in sugar, has put cereals generally under the spotlight from healthy eating advocates. Kellogg's stressed the cereals contain no artificial colours, flavours or sweeteners and the nutritional benefits in each bowl, such as fibre, Vitamin D and iron are staying the same. However, the new recipes mean packaging will now include a "contains wheat gluten" warning. Previously packaging said the products "may contain gluten" because they were made in a factory handling other cereals and there was a risk of cross-contamination. - Watch: How does El Niño affect world weather? - Published21 August Kellogg's said it has not changed the recipe for any of its other cereals. items.articleTextTr: Kellogg's admits snap, crackle and pop is quieter after uproar over Rice Krispies recipe change - Published Kellogg's has told the BBC the "snap, crackle and pop" sound made by its Rice Krispies may be noticeably quieter after an uproar over the cereal giant's recipe change. Rice Krispies and Coco Pops are no longer being made with whole rice grains, with the tiny toasted puffs being made using corn flour and rice flour instead. A Kellogg's spokesperson said retaining the iconic sound had been a "huge focus" when designing the new recipe, but that customers "might notice that the sound may be quieter and not as instant as before". It followed an online uproar about changes to the breakfast staples, with some fans saying they had lost the "pop" sound altogether. Kellogg's said the recipe was altered due to "changing weather conditions" that have disrupted supplies of some grains and cereals. The cereal giant said the new versions had been "carefully assessed for taste, appearance and texture", but fans complained online they no longer made the famous "pop" sound and said their children would no longer eat them. Some expressed dismay that the taste and texture were "totally different" and dubbed the change "grim" and "disgusting". "There's no snap, crackle and pop in these," a parent named Dani wrote on TikTok. "My toddler won't eat them." Lauren, also posting on TikTok, added that she had been eating Rice Krispies every day for breakfast "for years and years". "I had a bowl of the new recipe and you can immediately tell the difference," she said. "They don't have the snapping sound when you put in the milk." Jessicake meanwhile said they tasted "weird and stale". The "Snap, Crackle and Pop" - made when milk is added to the puffed rice - has been a centrepiece of the brand's marketing since the 1950s. Kellogg's insisted the snap, crackle and pop is "still there, but consumers might notice that the sound may be quieter and not as instant as before". Recipe changes are notoriously difficult for big brands. Chocolate makers are constantly accused of reducing cocoa content in their products and debates rage online over whether ketchup ingredients have changed. When Scottish fizzy drink Irn Bru cut its sugar content in 2018, fans famously stockpiled crates of the old version. No changes are being made to Rice Krispies products in the US and Canada. Kellogg's said the recipe change in the UK would help "maintain consistent quality" as extreme weather takes a toll on crops and pushes up ingredient prices. Extreme weather in Spain in 2022 and 2023 in particular had reduced availability of the types of rice the company uses for its breakfast cereals, the company said Rice Krispies, launched nearly a century ago, are sold around the world and come in variations such as vanilla and strawberry flavours in some markets alongside the widespread chocolate-flavoured Coco Pops version. "We appreciate that even small changes to a much-loved product can feel noticeable and that's why we have approached this with a lot of care and consideration," Kellogg's said. The firm said it appreciated the customer feedback and would "continue to look at ways to make [its] products even better in the future". The cereals have already undergone some change, with reductions in salt content in the 1990s and lowered sugar in 2018. The company said Rice Krispies and Coco Pops will continue to meet UK food standards on levels of fat, salt and sugar in food. A backlash against processed foods in recent years, especially those low in fibre and high in sugar, has put cereals generally under the spotlight from healthy eating advocates. Kellogg's stressed the cereals contain no artificial colours, flavours or sweeteners and the nutritional benefits in each bowl, such as fibre, Vitamin D and iron are staying the same. items.articleText: Avrupa'da siber saldırı dalgası: Bu kez kan bankaları hedefte - Avrupa genelinde soğutma sistemlerine yönelik siber saldırılar kan bankalarına sıçradı. Fransa'da kan ürünlerinin saklandığı soğuk hava depolarının sıcaklıkları bilgisayar korsanları tarafından uzaktan yükseltildi. Yetkililer, saldırıda herhangi bir kan ürününün zarar görmediğini açıkladı. Fransız Kan Kurumu (EFS), pazartesi günü üç tesisindeki soğuk depolama sistemlerinin siber saldırıdan etkilendiğini duyurdu. Kurumun açıklamasına göre, dış hizmet sağlayıcıları tarafından işletilen sistemlere uzaktan müdahale eden bilgisayar korsanları, sıcaklık ve buz çözme eşiklerini aşırı yüksek seviyelere çıkardı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Saldırıdan etkilenen depolarda kan ürünleri, dondurulmuş plazma ve biyolojik örnekler muhafaza ediliyordu. Alarm sistemleri olası zararı önledi EFS, izleme ve alarm sistemlerinin anormallikleri hızla tespit ettiğini, etkilenen ekipmanların kontrol altına alındığını veya devre dışı bırakıldığını bildirdi. Kurum, saldırı nedeniyle herhangi bir kan ürünü ya da biyolojik örneğin kaybedilmediğini, gerekli ürünlerin diğer tesislere aktarıldığını açıkladı. Fransa Sağlık Bakanlığı da durumun kontrol altında olduğunu ve kan tedarikinin güvenliğinin sağlandığını belirtti. Avrupa'da yüzlerce market de etkilenmişti Siber saldırılar daha önce Fransa, Belçika, İsveç ve Finlandiya'daki yüzlerce süpermarketin soğutma sistemlerini hedef almıştı. Uzaktan yükseltilen sıcaklıkların milyonlarca euro değerinde gıda ürününün bozulmasına yol açmış olabileceği belirtilmişti. EFS, olayın ardından Fransa Ulusal Siber Güvenlik Ajansı (ANSSI) ve Sağlık Bakanlığı ile koordinasyon halinde güvenlik önlemlerini artırdı.

items.titleTr: James Talarico becomes first Democrat to win Texas Senate seat since 1988
items.summaryTr: "This wasn't just a tsunami, not just a referendum, but this was a bloodbath," one expert told the BBC on Democrats' historic wins in Texas.
items.articleText: James Talarico becomes first Democrat to win Texas Senate seat since 1988 - Published Democrat James Talarico has won the Senate race in Texas, facing off more than $200m in opposition spending and creating one of the biggest upsets for Republicans in the midterms. Talarico's stunning victory over Republican Ken Paxton marks the first time a Democrat has won a US Senate seat in Texas since 1988 - and helped solidify Democrats taking control of the US Congress in a wave of wins across America. Talarico, a former schoolteacher, was little-known until last year. He made the rising cost of living under Republican leadership a central theme of his run. Paxton sought to portray Talarico's views as too progressive for the state, and campaigned alongside Trump on several occasions. In a further, historic victory for Democrats in the state, Gina Hinojosa will become the first Latina governor in Texas, ousting Republican incumbent Greg Abbott - one of the nation's highest profile governors and a long-standing Trump supporter. At a watch party in Austin, the state's capital, there were jubilant scenes among Talarico supporters as giant television screens projected him the winner on Tuesday night. Supporters hugged, they kissed, and they drank to a reality that many say they dared not believe would come true. Emerging on stage to rapturous applause at his official watch party at a nearby performing arts theatre, Talarico pronounced: "We just took back Texas." "We just proved that all the money in the world is no match for the people of Texas," he continued, referring to his win over Paxton whose campaign was backed by Elon Musk, the world's richest man. He invoked religious themes that have grown familiar to his campaign, comparing his unlikely odds to the biblical story of David and Goliath. "This win, this win is for every Texan who's ever wondered if anyone is listening," he said. "I hear you, we hear you. And tonight the world hears you." For decades, the idea of a Democrat winning a statewide race had felt like a pipe dream for Texas liberals. As the nation's second most populous state, Texas has been a bastion of conservatism, routinely rolling out Republican policies that are later employed elsewhere. But throughout the campaign, polls suggested state legislator Talarico was breaking through with voters, energising a Texas Democratic base desperate for new leadership. Spending in the race skyrocketed, and it quickly grew to become the most expensive US Senate race in history, with more than half a billion dollars spent. Billionaire Elon Musk poured in $158m (£117m) to a super PAC supporting Paxton's campaign - a point that Talarico used in attacks on Paxton's campaign. Speaking to CBS on Wednesday morning after his victory, Talarico said Musk "wanted a senator who was going to do his bidding, who was going to sell off Texas land to his data centers, who was going to give [away] our Texas water". "I think last night the people of Texas delivered a crystal clear message to the world's first trillionaire: Texas is not for sale," he said. Then two members of the Bush family, the Republican political dynasty that counts Texas as its political launchpad, backed Talarico in a stunning move foreshadowing Paxton's doom. George Washington University political science professor Quardricos Driskell told the BBC that Paxton was a major part of Republicans' downfall, calling him an "objectively terrible candidate". He said the win in Texas by Talarico, combined with another upset on Tuesday that ousted the state's Republican governor Greg Abbott, was "absolutely historic". Abbott's loss marked the first time a Democrat had won a race for governor in the state since the 1990s. "This wasn't just a tsunami, not just a referendum, but this was a bloodbath," Driskell said about Democrats gains in the Lone Star State. "A clear distinction that the country wants to go in a different direction". Talarico defeated a well-known opponent, Dallas Congresswoman Jasmine Crockett, in the Democratic primary. Then continued to maintain good polling numbers despite an onslaught of negative adverts, including attacks on past comments where he supported transgender people. Throughout his campaign, he frequently leaned into his religious upbringing – as the grandson of a Southern Baptist preacher who spent time in a seminary – sprinkling his stump speeches with biblical references. Paxton had been beleaguered by a number of political scandals, including his impeachment by his own party in 2023 on corruption accusations, before he was later acquitted by the state's Senate. He was also indicted by the US Securities and Exchange Commission on federal fraud charges, but they were later dismissed. Trump made multiple stops in Texas to beef up support for Paxton and other Republicans - including in reliably-Republican spots, signalling how concerned party leadership was about turnout. Voters have been frustrated with high consumer costs, including the price of petrol, and largely blame Trump's tariff policies and the Iran war. Hispanic voters and those who live along the southern US border have also taken issue with Trump's immigration policies. Despite border crossings plummeting under Trump - something that had been popular with Texas voters - polls suggested Trump's support among Hispanics, who make up a third of the state's population, had ebbed significantly. Surveys taken since late summer indicated a majority of Texan Hispanic voters - many of whom switched to Trump to help him win the White House in 2024 - now disapproved of the president. They also suggested that Hispanic voters were favouring Democrats over Republicans by a significant margin. Many Texas Hispanics who spoke to the BBC before the election pointed to Trump's immigration crackdown as the reasoning behind their change of heart. They pointed to aggressive measures that led to citizens being detained and non-violent offenders being rounded up indiscriminately. Reacting to the result on Truth Social, Trump wrote: "If Greg Abbott, the Governor of Texas, hadn't become a RINO [Republican in name only] in the last six months of his Political Life, he wouldn't have lost." Follow the twists and turns of Trump's second term with North America correspondent Anthony Zurcher's US Politics Unspun newsletter. Readers in the UK can sign up here. items.title: Everything you need to know from the US midterm elections
items.summary: Democrats secured some big wins - and a few historic firsts - earning congratulations from President Trump.

items.titleTr: Everything you need to know from the US midterm elections
items.summaryTr: Democrats secured some big wins - and a few historic firsts - earning congratulations from President Trump.
items.articleText: Everything you need to know from the US midterm elections - Published Democrats have won both the US Senate and House of Representatives, taking control of Congress for the rest of Donald Trump's presidency. Projected results have provided the party with a number of things to celebrate - and rival Republicans some reasons to commiserate. Here is everything you need to know about some of the big Democratic wins and some historic firsts. Democrats toast victories in deep-red Trump country Democrats have tallied up victories in states that were comfortably won by Trump two years ago in the presidential election. With James Talarico winning a seat in the US Senate seat and Gina Hinojosa being elected state governor, Democrats scored two statewide victories in Texas - ending a string of defeats they have endured for almost two generations. Talarico's supporters went beserk as the projected results arrived at an election-night party, wrote the BBC's Gary O'Donoghue. Attendees hugged, kissed and drank to a reality they dared not believe would come true. Hinojosa became the first Latina to be elected governor of the state. Among the other states where history was made by the Democrats were Kansas, where Adam Hamilton took a closely-fought Senate seat - giving the state its first Democratic senator for nearly a century. Senior party figures who cheered the results included Hakeem Jeffries, the top Democrat in the House of Representatives, who is now poised to take over as the Speaker of the lower chamber of Congress. "Today begins the great American comeback," he told a crowd of supporters. If Jeffries' colleagues choose to keep him as the leader of their party's delegation in House, he will be the next Speaker, taking over from Republican Mike Johnson and becoming the first black person to fill that role. Trump congratulates opposition and acknowledges Iran and fuel prices were issues Trump spoke throughout the evening to a number of US media outlets, striking a conciliatory tone and conceding that the Democrats did a "good job". He said he would accept the results and that he was looking forward to working with the opposition party - albeit he would still have the power, as president, to veto legislation that Democrats advance through Congress. Trump distanced himself from some of the Republican candidates who contested the election, saying: "In some cases they didn't like the candidates, and in some cases those candidates were not my friend." He acknowledged that the US-Israel war on Iran, which has impacted consumer prices in the US, had affected the vote. Trump argued that high fuel prices meant voters could not see how well his economy was doing "as much as they should have", adding: "The gasoline was caused by Iran." El-Sayed wins US Senate race in Michigan after fellow Democrat turns on him Abdul El-Sayed has become the first Muslim person elected to the US Senate - after claiming victory in Michigan in what was one of a handful of closely fought contests. His win means the seat stays in Democratic hands. He defeated Republican opponent Mike Rogers, who received the surprise backing of El-Sayed's Democratic rival in the primary contest, Haley Stevens, who changed her endorsement at the eleventh hour. The race was one of the bitterest of the midterms. Trump invoked 9/11 and even called El-Sayed a "jihadist" without citing any evidence, prompting a backlash and accusations of Islamophobia. El-Sayed's supporters went wild when he took the stage to celebrate his claimed victory, wrote the BBC's Nada Tawfik. He said: "Up until right about now, you might have noticed I always say 'inshallah,' or 'God willing,' whenever the outcome of this race was mentioned." He went on to say: "But today, tonight, we can turn that 'inshallah' into 'alhamdulillah'. For the right-wing ops, that just means 'praise be to God.'" Republicans unable to win by distancing from Trump The defeat of Susan Collins, who has served as the Republican senator for Maine for three decades, was one indicator of the scale of the Republican losses. She was felled by Democratic candidate Troy Jackson, a logger who sought to point to his background to persuade blue-collar Mainers to vote for him. In a statement reported by US media, Collins conceded defeat and said it had been the "honour of my life" to serve the state for 30 years. The BBC's Helena Humphrey described a sombre atmosphere at Collins's watch party in the city of Maine - where the song Closing Time was played. Collins entered the race as one of the most vulnerable incumbent Republicans seeking re-election, and found that her tactic to distance herself from Trump did not work. Ashley Hinson suffered the same fate in Iowa, losing that closely-fought Senate seat to Josh Turek. Hinson had slightly distanced herself from the president, urging him to end the war with Iran and breaking with him on easing beef tariffs, while at the same time defending Trump's broader tariff policies as important. History made by new black governors, first openly gay male senator and first Gen Z congresswoman Among the other firsts of the night were in Florida, where Republican Byron Donalds has become the state's first black governor, following a hearty endorsement from Trump. Donalds, who will take over the job from Ron DeSantis, said his state was the "envy of the nation", and that he would work to make the state more affordable. The result was one of the few high points of an otherwise difficult evening for the Republicans. Pappas defeated former Republican Senator John Sununu in the race, whom he thanked on Tuesday, saying: "We all owe John Sununu a big debt of gratitude for his public service for the people of New Hampshire." items.articleTextTr: Everything you need to know from the US midterm elections - Published Democrats have won both the US Senate and House of Representatives, taking control of Congress for the rest of Donald Trump's presidency. Projected results have provided the party with a number of things to celebrate - and rival Republicans some reasons to commiserate. Here is everything you need to know about some of the big Democratic wins and some historic firsts. Democrats toast victories in deep-red Trump country Democrats have tallied up victories in states that were comfortably won by Trump two years ago in the presidential election. With James Talarico winning a seat in the US Senate seat and Gina Hinojosa being elected state governor, Democrats scored two statewide victories in Texas - ending a string of defeats they have endured for almost two generations. Talarico's supporters went beserk as the projected results arrived at an election-night party, wrote the BBC's Gary O'Donoghue. Attendees hugged, kissed and drank to a reality they dared not believe would come true. Hinojosa became the first Latina to be elected governor of the state. Among the other states where history was made by the Democrats were Kansas, where Adam Hamilton took a closely-fought Senate seat - giving the state its first Democratic senator for nearly a century. Senior party figures who cheered the results included Hakeem Jeffries, the top Democrat in the House of Representatives, who is now poised to take over as the Speaker of the lower chamber of Congress. "Today begins the great American comeback," he told a crowd of supporters. If Jeffries' colleagues choose to keep him as the leader of their party's delegation in House, he will be the next Speaker, taking over from Republican Mike Johnson and becoming the first black person to fill that role. Trump congratulates opposition and acknowledges Iran and fuel prices were issues Trump spoke throughout the evening to a number of US media outlets, striking a conciliatory tone and conceding that the Democrats did a "good job". He said he would accept the results and that he was looking forward to working with the opposition party - albeit he would still have the power, as president, to veto legislation that Democrats advance through Congress. Trump distanced himself from some of the Republican candidates who contested the election, saying: "In some cases they didn't like the candidates, and in some cases those candidates were not my friend." He acknowledged that the US-Israel war on Iran, which has impacted consumer prices in the US, had affected the vote. Trump argued that high fuel prices meant voters could not see how well his economy was doing "as much as they should have", adding: "The gasoline was caused by Iran." items.title: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
items.verification: Birincil kaynak
items.titleTr: CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets
items.articleText: Release Number 9321-26 CFTC and USDA Sign MOU to Protect Integrity of American Agricultural Markets November 04, 2026 WASHINGTON — The Commodity Futures Trading Commission and the U.S. Department of Agriculture today announced their signing of a Memorandum of Understanding intended to safeguard the integrity of U.S. agricultural markets. The MOU will allow the CFTC and USDA to harmonize policies and practices to better share information and increase access to risk management tools. The agreement will also assist both agencies with monitoring and identifying structural or potential systematic risks, among other things. “For decades, America’s agricultural community has relied on our markets to hedge risk, manage uncertainty, and plan for the future,” said CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig. “I’m proud that the CFTC and USDA have formalized this partnership through an MOU that will strengthen protections for America’s farmers, ranchers, and producers while expanding opportunities to manage risk through more efficient data sharing. I commend Secretary Rollins for her partnership and commitment to a more coordinated regulatory approach that safeguards the integrity of our markets and ensures they continue serving the agricultural community that feeds and clothes our nation.” “Faster and more transparent data sharing between USDA and CFTC is critical to helping our farmers and ranchers navigate an ever-changing market,” said USDA Secretary Brooke Rollins. “This MOU builds upon USDA’s ongoing data modernization efforts and allows our agencies to collaboratively identify risks and improve responses to market events. Breaking down barriers between government agencies to deliver for our customers is a hallmark of this administration and I am looking forward to the successes this MOU will bring.” -CFTC-

items.articleText: ABD'nin dış ticaret açığı eylülde beklentinin aksine daraldı - ABD'de eylül ayına ilişkin dış ticaret verileri açıklandı. Ülkenin dış ticaret açığı 105 milyar dolara gerileyerek 107,9 milyar dolarlık piyasa beklentisinin altında kaldı. Aynı dönemde ihracat yüzde 1,9 artışla 321,51 milyar dolara, ithalat ise yüzde 1,2 yükselişle 426,56 milyar dolara ulaştı. ABD'de eylül ayına ilişkin dış ticaret verileri açıklandı. Ülkenin dış ticaret açığı 105 milyar dolar olarak gerçekleşerek piyasanın 107,9 milyar dolarlık beklentisinin altında kaldı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Açıklanan verilere göre ABD'nin ihracatı, eylülde bir önceki aya kıyasla yüzde 1,9 artarak 315,67 milyar dolardan 321,51 milyar dolara yükseldi. Önceki dönemde ihracattaki artış yüzde 1,6 olmuştu. İthalat ise yüzde 1,2 yükselişle 426,56 milyar dolara ulaştı. Bir önceki ay 421,4 milyar dolar seviyesinde bulunan ithalatta yüzde 4,4'lük artış kaydedilmişti. Mal ticareti açığı 135 milyar dolara yükseldi Eylülde ABD'nin mal ticareti açığı, önceki dönemdeki 134,9 milyar dolardan 135 milyar dolara çıktı. Öte yandan ağustos ayına ilişkin toplam dış ticaret açığı verisi 105,6 milyar dolardan 105,7 milyar dolara revize edildi. Daha önce açıklanan 92,8 milyar dolarlık rakam da önceki revizyon referansı olarak bildirildi.

items.summary: ABD'de özel sektör istihdamı ekimde 86 bin kişi artarak 67 bin kişilik piyasa beklentisini aştı. İstihdam artışının 82 bini hizmet sektöründen geldi.

items.summaryTr: ABD'de özel sektör istihdamı ekimde 86 bin kişi artarak 67 bin kişilik piyasa beklentisini aştı. İstihdam artışının 82 bini hizmet sektöründen geldi.
items.articleText: ABD'de özel sektör istihdamı beklentileri aştı: Ekimde 86 bin kişilik artış - ABD'de özel sektör istihdamı ekimde 86 bin kişi artarak 67 bin kişilik piyasa beklentisini aştı. İstihdam artışının 82 bini hizmet sektöründen geldi. ABD'de özel sektör istihdamı ekimde 86 bin kişi artarak piyasa beklentilerinin üzerinde gerçekleşti. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle ADP Araştırma Enstitüsünün, Stanford Dijital Ekonomi Laboratuvarı (Stanford Lab) işbirliğiyle hazırladığı ekim ayına ilişkin Ulusal İstihdam Raporu yayımlandı. Buna göre, ABD'de özel sektör istihdamı ekimde 86 bin kişi arttı. Piyasa beklentisi, özel sektör istihdamının bu dönemde 67 bin kişi artması yönündeydi. Özel sektör istihdamında eylülde kaydedilen artışa ilişkin veri ise 90 binden 86 bine revize edildi. Ekimde istihdam artışı hizmet sektöründe 82 bin, üretim sektöründe 4 bin oldu. ABD'de 26 milyondan fazla özel sektör çalışanının bordro bilgileri kullanılarak hazırlanan ADP verilerine göre, yıllık temel ücret artışı ekimde aynı işte kalan çalışanlar için yüzde 3 olurken, iş değiştiren çalışanlar için yüzde 4,8 olarak kaydedildi. ADP Araştırma Enstitüsü Başekonomisti Nela Richardson, verilere ilişkin değerlendirmesinde, geçen ay her büyüklükteki işverenin işe alım yaptığını belirtti. Verilerin, iş değiştiren çalışanların daha yüksek temel ücretin yanı sıra ikramiyeler, fazla mesai ödemeleri ve daha uzun çalışma saatlerinin birleşimiyle yeni işlere yöneldiğine işaret ettiğini aktaran Richardson, bu çalışanların toplam kazançlarındaki artışın Mart 2024'ten bu yana en hızlı seviyeye ulaştığını söyledi.

items.articleText: Here’s what happened in crypto today Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation. Today in crypto, Democrats won control of Congress as a CertiK executive warned the CLARITY bill was “likely dead.” In Europe, ZachXBT identified French banking group Crédit Mutuel Arkéa as the suspected victim of a crypto theft exceeding $133 million. Democrats win Congress as CLARITY bill faces fresh doubts Democrats have won control of both chambers of the US Congress in the midterm elections, giving the party greater influence over crypto legislation and oversight of President Donald Trump’s administration. At the time of writing, Democrats had secured 228 House seats to Republicans’ 139, with 68 races still uncalled, according to the Associated Press. The Senate tally stood at 54 seats for Democrats and 44 for Republicans. The result could derail the CLARITY crypto market structure bill, according to Stefan Muehlbauer, head of US government affairs at CertiK. “The immediate read on this election result is that CLARITY bill is likely dead,” he said in comments shared with Cointelegraph, referring to both the upcoming lame-duck session and the next Congress. Muehlbauer said he expected Sen. Elizabeth Warren and Rep. Maxine Waters, both outspoken crypto critics, to chair the Senate Banking Committee and House Financial Services Committee, respectively. Democratic control could also bring greater congressional scrutiny of Trump-linked digital asset businesses. ZachXBT identifies French bank as alleged victim of $133M crypto theft Onchain investigator ZachXBT has identified French banking group Crédit Mutuel Arkéa as the alleged victim of a crypto theft exceeding $133 million, warning that total losses could be higher. On Wednesday, the pseudonymous crypto sleuth said the institution, which he described as having $235 billion in assets, was allegedly exploited over multiple days. He also suggested that additional losses may have occurred through over-the-counter (OTC) transactions that were not included in earlier estimates. “I suspect the amount stolen is larger when accounting for OTC activity,” ZachXBT said. The bank’s alleged involvement has not been independently verified, and ZachXBT has not disclosed how the attackers gained access to the funds. The disclosure follows ZachXBT’s initial report on Monday, when he identified over $106 million in suspicious withdrawals from centralized exchanges. On Tuesday, he raised the estimated losses to over $133 million after discovering another $27 million in withdrawals, some of which occurred after his initial warning.

İhaleler yoluyla piyasalardan yaklaşık 28 milyar dolarlık yeni kaynak sağlanması hedefleniyor. ABD Hazine Bakanlığı, kasım ayına ilişkin borçlanma programının ayrıntılarını duyurdu. Bakanlık, 15 Kasım 2026'da vadesi dolacak yaklaşık 97 milyar dolarlık borcun yeniden finansmanı için toplam 125 milyar dolarlık tahvil ihracı gerçekleştirecek. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Planlanan ihraçlarla özel sektör yatırımcılarından yaklaşık 28 milyar dolarlık ilave finansman sağlanacak. Üç farklı vadede tahvil ihraç edilecek Açıklamaya göre, borçlanma programı kapsamında 58 milyar dolarlık 3 yıl, 42 milyar dolarlık 10 yıl ve 25 milyar dolarlık 30 yıl vadeli tahvil ihraç edilecek. İhale takvimine göre 3 yıl vadeli tahviller 9 Kasım Pazartesi, 10 yıl vadeli tahviller 10 Kasım Salı ve 30 yıl vadeli tahviller 12 Kasım Perşembe günü satışa sunulacak. İhalelerin tamamı Türkiye saatiyle 21.00'de gerçekleştirilecek. Tahvillerin takas işlemleri ise 16 Kasım Pazartesi günü tamamlanacak. Finansman ihtiyacı farklı araçlarla karşılanacak ABD Hazinesi, yılın son çeyreğinde kalan finansman ihtiyacını karşılamak için düzenli borçlanma araçlarını kullanmayı sürdürecek. Bu kapsamda haftalık bono ihaleleri, nakit yönetimi bonoları ve aylık tahvil ihraçlarının yanı sıra enflasyona endeksli tahviller (TIPS) ile 2 yıl vadeli değişken faizli tahviller de kullanılacak.

Adnan Dalgakıran 86, Ender Yılmaz 67 oy aldı. Çelik İhracatçıları Birliği (ÇİB) Başkan Vekili Mustafa Tecdelioğlu, İstanbul Sanayi Odası (İSO) Meclis Başkanlığı'na seçildi. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle İstanbul Sanayi Odası Başkanlığı seçimlerini Adnan Dalgakıran kazandı. Adnan Dalgakıran 86, Ender Yılmaz 67 oy aldı. İstanbul Sanayi Odası (İSO) seçim sürecine ilişkin değerlendirmelerde bulunan Adnan Dalgakıran, odanın geleceğine yönelik yeni bir vizyon ortaya koymak için çalışacaklarını belirtti. 'Geleceğe yönelik yeni bir vizyon koymak için çaba sarf edeceğiz' Dalgakıran, İSO'nun köklü tarihine yakışır bir seçim süreci geçirdiklerini ifade ederek, "Geleceğe yönelik yeni bir vizyon koymak için çaba sarf edeceğiz." dedi. Dünyanın hızlı bir değişim içinde olduğuna dikkati çeken Dalgakıran, kurumların da bu değişime ayak uydurması gerektiğini vurguladı. Dalgakıran, "Biz de değişmek zorundayız, dünya hızlı değişiyor. İSO'da 21. yüzyıla yakışan bir organizasyon yapacağız." ifadelerini kullandı.

items.title: France backs reporting for self-custodied crypto worth 100K euros or more
items.summary: The amendment would require taxpayers to report holdings worth at least $112,000, but the measure still needs to survive the budget process.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: France backs reporting for self-custodied crypto worth 100K euros or more
items.summaryTr: The amendment would require taxpayers to report holdings worth at least $112,000, but the measure still needs to survive the budget process.
items.articleText: France backs reporting for self-custodied crypto worth 100K euros or more The amendment would require taxpayers to report holdings worth at least $112,000, but the measure still needs to survive the budget process. The French National Assembly approved an amendment that would require taxpayers to report self-custodied crypto holdings totaling at least 100,000 euros ($112,000) to tax authorities. Amendment I-2701 was adopted on Tuesday in a 150–44 vote, with eight abstentions, according to the Assembly’s official voting record. The threshold would be assessed on Dec. 31 of the relevant tax year. Separately, the Assembly rejected an amendment that would have exempted gains on crypto payments for goods and services from tax if the payments totaled no more than 1,000 euros ($1,120) during the tax year. The proposal was defeated 69–14, according to the Assembly’s transcript. The reporting requirement forms part of the 2027 Finance Bill and would need to be retained in the final legislation to become law. The Assembly faces a Nov. 17 deadline to complete its first reading of the bill. Senate debate is scheduled to begin Nov. 20, according to its schedule. Crypto measures await final budget approval The National Assembly postponed Tuesday’s scheduled vote on the budget’s revenue section for the second time as lawmakers continued debating amendments. The vote was originally scheduled for Oct. 20. The vote’s postponement itself does not introduce a significant change, but the “likely rejection” of the budget’s revenue section could “result in the rejection of the entire bill in the National Assembly, including provisions adopted by way of amendments,” Faustine Fleuret, global head of public affairs at lending protocol Morpho, told Cointelegraph. On Friday, the Assembly rejected two proposals that would have applied exit taxes to unrealized crypto gains when taxpayers transferred their tax residence abroad. Lawmakers also approved an amendment on Oct. 16 that would tax gains from converting crypto into stablecoins. The proposal covers stablecoins classified as electronic money tokens under EU rules and would still need to be retained in the final law. Related: French Senate adopts bill for automatic sharing of crypto tax data

items.title: Elon Musk's millions fail to deliver Texas for the Republicans in fierce midterms
items.summary: The billionaire's political action committee (Pac) contributed $47m (£35m) to Ken Paxton's campaign.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: Elon Musk's millions fail to deliver Texas for the Republicans in fierce midterms
items.summaryTr: The billionaire's political action committee (Pac) contributed $47m (£35m) to Ken Paxton's campaign.
items.articleText: Elon Musk's millions fail to deliver Texas for the Republicans in fierce midterms - Published Democrat James Talarico's resounding victory in the Texas Senate race caused a major upset in the midterms for Republicans - and for Elon Musk. According to the Financial Times, external, the billionaire's political action committee (Pac) contributed $47m (£35m) to Republican candidate Ken Paxton's campaign, on top of the $158m he gave the Senate Leadership Fund in September. The money was not enough to stop the seat from turning Democrat for the first time since 1988. In his acceptance speech, Talarico said: "We just proved that all the money in the world is no match for the people of Texas." "Guess my election-interfering space lasers didn't work this time," Musk jokingly wrote on X, external. Talarico's victory marked a key turning point in the midterms, helping solidify the Democrats' control of the US Congress in a wave of wins across the US. Musk has increasingly made Texas the hub of his companies, from Tesla's Austin headquarters to SpaceX's Starbase launch site. As well as backing Paxton through outside groups, the X owner took to his own platform to spread conspiracy theories about the Democrat, posting: "There is something deeply wrong with Talarico" after he briefly disappeared from the campaign trail in October. "There is something deeply wrong with a political system that allows one trillionaire to buy his own personal US Senator," Talarico posted in response. On top of contributing to one of the most expensive Senate races ever, the SpaceX owner also became the top individual donor in this year's midterms overall, contributing an estimated $446m in backing Republican candidates. Musk's money went through Super Pacs, groups which can raise unlimited sums but can't give directly to candidates or coordinate with their campaigns. Individuals, parties and traditional groups face legal limits on direct donations. Super Pacs get around this by spending independently, such as on ads backing a candidate. Musk became one of the Republican Party's biggest donors in 2024, pouring hundreds of millions of dollars into Donald Trump's winning presidential campaign. items.title: ABD seçimleri Musk'ın şirketlerini vurdu: Tesla ve SpaceX hisselerinde sert düşüş
items.summary: ABD ara seçimlerinde Demokratların Kongre'nin iki kanadında da kontrolü ele geçirmesinin ardından Elon Musk'ın şirketleri Tesla ve SpaceX'in hisselerinde düşüş yaşandı.
items.verification: Editoryal haber; resmî duyuru olarak değerlendirilmemeli
items.titleTr: ABD seçimleri Musk'ın şirketlerini vurdu: Tesla ve SpaceX hisselerinde sert düşüş
items.summaryTr: ABD ara seçimlerinde Demokratların Kongre'nin iki kanadında da kontrolü ele geçirmesinin ardından Elon Musk'ın şirketleri Tesla ve SpaceX'in hisselerinde düşüş yaşandı.
items.articleText: ABD seçimleri Musk'ın şirketlerini vurdu: Tesla ve SpaceX hisselerinde sert düşüş - ABD ara seçimlerinde Demokratların Kongre'nin iki kanadında da kontrolü ele geçirmesinin ardından Elon Musk'ın şirketleri Tesla ve SpaceX'in hisselerinde düşüş yaşandı. - Yatırımcılar, yapay zeka düzenlemelerinin sıkılaşması ve iki şirketin olası birleşmesinin daha fazla incelemeye tabi tutulması ihtimalini değerlendiriyor. ABD'de ara seçimlerde Demokratların Kongre'nin kontrolünü ele geçirmesinin ardından Elon Musk'ın sahibi olduğu Tesla ve SpaceX'in hisseleri geriledi. Yatırımcıların yapay zeka sektöründe düzenlemelerin sıkılaşabileceği ve iki şirket arasında olası birleşmenin zorlaşabileceği endişeleri satış baskısını artırdı. CNBCE.COM'u öncelikli haber kaynağınız olarak ekleyin Ekle Al Jazeera'nın haberine göre, Tesla hisseleri çarşamba günü piyasa açılışı öncesi işlemlerde yaklaşık yüzde 5 düşerken, SpaceX hisseleri önceki kapanışına kıyasla yüzde 6,9 geriledi. Her iki hisse de ilerleyen işlemlerde kayıplarının bir bölümünü telafi etti. Demokratların özellikle Teksas'ta elde ettiği başarı, Tesla ve SpaceX'in merkezlerini bu eyalete taşıyan Musk açısından da dikkat çekti. Musk, seçim sürecinde Cumhuriyetçilere destek vermiş ve Demokratlara oy verilmemesi çağrısında bulunmuştu. Yapay zeka düzenlemeleri ve birleşme endişesi First New York'tan Vikram Rai, Demokratların seçimlerdeki başarısının iki şirketin yatırımcıları açısından çifte risk oluşturabileceğini belirtti. Rai, Demokratların Kongre'de kontrolü sağlamasının yapay zeka alanında daha sıkı düzenlemeler getirilmesi ve Tesla ile SpaceX arasında olası birleşmenin önündeki engellerin artması ihtimalini güçlendirdiğini ifade etti. ABD'li haber sitelerinin konuya yakın kaynaklara dayandırdığı haberine göre, iki şirket arasında bir anlaşmanın gelecek yılın ilk yarısında duyurulması ve Donald Trump'ın başkanlık dönemi sona ermeden tamamlanması yönünde girişimler bulunuyor. Birleşme ihtimali henüz araştırma aşamasında bulunuyor. Olası işlem, iki şirketin faaliyet alanları ve büyüklükleri nedeniyle düzenleyici kurumların incelemesine konu olabilir. Musk ise seçim sonuçlarının ardından X hesabından yaptığı paylaşımda, uzayda veri merkezleri kurulmasının artık cazip bir seçenek gibi göründüğünü belirtti. Musk Cumhuriyetçilere 450 milyon dolar aktardı Haberde, Musk'ın seçim sürecinde Cumhuriyetçi Parti'nin finansmanına yaklaşık 450 milyon dolar katkı sağladığı ve X platformundaki 240 milyon takipçisine Demokratlara oy vermemeleri çağrısında bulunduğu aktarıldı. Tesla hisseleri, yapay zeka ürünlerine yönelik iyimser beklentiler ve SpaceX ile olası birleşme ihtimali sayesinde temmuz sonundaki dip seviyelerinden itibaren yüzde 34 yükselmişti. Haziran ayında halka arz edilen SpaceX ise dünyanın en değerli şirketleri arasına girmişti. Şirketin piyasa değeri yaklaşık 1,9 trilyon dolar seviyesinde bulunuyor. SpaceX ayrıca ABD hükümetiyle yaptığı sözleşmelerden milyarlarca dolar gelir elde ediyor. İki şirketin yapay zeka alanındaki faaliyetleri de olası düzenleyici incelemelerin odağında. Starlink'in askeri amaçlarla kullanılan versiyonuna erişim konusu ise ABD, Ukrayna ve Rusya arasındaki ilişkilerde gerilim yaratan başlıklardan biri olarak öne çıkıyor. Nationwide Funds Baş Stratejisti Mark Hackett, seçim öncesinde siyasi söylemlerin ve duyguların piyasalar üzerinde etkili olduğunu, seçimlerin ardından ise temel göstergelerin ve ekonomik gerçeklerin daha belirleyici hale geldiğini söyledi. Öte yandan Tesla ve SpaceX, ürün geliştirme çalışmalarına milyarlarca dolar harcamayı sürdürüyor. Ancak sürücüsüz taksi, insansı robotlar ve Mars'ta yerleşim gibi projelerin şirket gelirlerine anlamlı katkı sağlamasının önünde yıllar olduğu değerlendiriliyor.

ABD'li haber sitelerinin konuya yakın kaynaklara dayandırdığı haberine göre, iki şirket arasında bir anlaşmanın gelecek yılın ilk yarısında duyurulması ve Donald Trump'ın başkanlık dönemi sona ermeden tamamlanması yönünde girişimler bulunuyor. Birleşme ihtimali henüz araştırma aşamasında bulunuyor. Olası işlem, iki şirketin faaliyet alanları ve büyüklükleri nedeniyle düzenleyici kurumların incelemesine konu olabilir. Musk ise seçim sonuçlarının ardından X hesabından yaptığı paylaşımda, uzayda veri merkezleri kurulmasının artık cazip bir seçenek gibi göründüğünü belirtti. Musk Cumhuriyetçilere 450 milyon dolar aktardı Haberde, Musk'ın seçim sürecinde Cumhuriyetçi Parti'nin finansmanına yaklaşık 450 milyon dolar katkı sağladığı ve X platformundaki 240 milyon takipçisine Demokratlara oy vermemeleri çağrısında bulunduğu aktarıldı. Tesla hisseleri, yapay zeka ürünlerine yönelik iyimser beklentiler ve SpaceX ile olası birleşme ihtimali sayesinde temmuz sonundaki dip seviyelerinden itibaren yüzde 34 yükselmişti. Haziran ayında halka arz edilen SpaceX ise dünyanın en değerli şirketleri arasına girmişti. Şirketin piyasa değeri yaklaşık 1,9 trilyon dolar seviyesinde bulunuyor. SpaceX ayrıca ABD hükümetiyle yaptığı sözleşmelerden milyarlarca dolar gelir elde ediyor. İki şirketin yapay zeka alanındaki faaliyetleri de olası düzenleyici incelemelerin odağında. Starlink'in askeri amaçlarla kullanılan versiyonuna erişim konusu ise ABD, Ukrayna ve Rusya arasındaki ilişkilerde gerilim yaratan başlıklardan biri olarak öne çıkıyor. Nationwide Funds Baş Stratejisti Mark Hackett, seçim öncesinde siyasi söylemlerin ve duyguların piyasalar üzerinde etkili olduğunu, seçimlerin ardından ise temel göstergelerin ve ekonomik gerçeklerin daha belirleyici hale geldiğini söyledi. Öte yandan Tesla ve SpaceX, ürün geliştirme çalışmalarına milyarlarca dolar harcamayı sürdürüyor. Ancak sürücüsüz taksi, insansı robotlar ve Mars'ta yerleşim gibi projelerin şirket gelirlerine anlamlı katkı sağlamasının önünde yıllar olduğu değerlendiriliyor.

items.title: 'This is a disaster': Angry Republicans blame Trump for midterms defeat
items.summary: Some Republicans tell the BBC the president's focus on his legacy and indifference to voter concerns cost them.
